fixer.title: agentHost: stop injecting the artifact tools reminder

introducer.title: agentHost: reduce artifact tool overhead with a prompt experiment

cases.mechanism: A long artifact reminder duplicated guidance already present in an always-loaded tool definition and was embedded in the first user prompt, causing that text to remain in the conversation context processed by subsequent model requests for the chat.
cases.symptom: Repeated model-input bytes/tokens and associated provider processing/user cost for artifact-enabled chats.
cases.fixedBehavior: The PR deletes ARTIFACT_TOOLS_INSTRUCTION and unregisters/deletes ArtifactToolsContribution, so new chats no longer append the duplicate reminder to their first model-visible prompt; the non-deferred add_artifact_or_reference tool description remains available with the required guidance.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, ArtifactToolsContribution.onOutgoingTurn returned ARTIFACT_TOOLS_INSTRUCTION on each chat's first outgoing turn; AgentSideEffects forwarded contribution instructions as hostInstructions into agent.chats.sendMessage. Copilot injects these as user-prompt additionalContext, Claude via getUserPromptAdditionalContext, and Codex via turn/start additionalContext, placing the long reminder into model context. The add_artifact_or_reference definition is deferLoading:false and already contains the same classification, batching, optional-registration, and exclusion guidance, so the separate reminder duplicated always-loaded tool text. The deleted base line 276 is the long duplicate prompt, and blame resolves it to b0dad94048b3b988c8aa325a46ce7998f2abe0bb.
